rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 3AB label and acknowledges no image was available, but it overstates stage 3 as fully expanded/thinning zona and inconsistently describes TE B as 'few cells forming a loose epithelium,' which is closer to C than classic B.
Integrates age, AMH, BMI, prior cycle, endometrium, and semen data with embryo quality well, though some inferences (e.g., DOR framing and male-factor implications) are somewhat speculative.

Overall logical and structured, with a reasonable prognosis framework, but there are minor inconsistencies in morphology interpretation and a slight overreach in calling one prior failed cycle a possible implantation issue.

Generally aligned on SET and luteal support, but recommendations such as routine PGT-A after one failed cycle, thrombophilia workup, and protocol switching are more speculative and not clearly guideline-driven for this exact scenario.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though some suggestions are broader than necessary and not all are tightly tailored to evidence thresholds.
